name: Favorable Winds: Allies you control get +1 LIFE until end of turn
notes: WIND is a basic element, unlocked via the established Subcards lineage-patch technique (Spirit of Wind, same shape as rising-tides/tera-sight). Activating this reserve-cost SPELL resolves through an EffectStack rather than the direct-resolution flow used by memory-cost activations elsewhere in this file -- after paying the 1-reserve cost, it queues an EffectStackActiveResponse 'respond?' opportunity (MZMAYCHOOSE); declining it ('-') lets it resolve (discovered via a throwaway debug harness, DevTools/debug_winds.php, that traced GlobalEffectCount step by step). AddGlobalEffects($player,'dsAqxMezGb') then applies to any ALLY-type object via $doesGlobalEffectApply['dsAqxMezGb'] (GameLogic.php:17660-17662), read back as +1 LIFE in the LIFE computation switch (~13680-13682). Base LIFE 3 (Dungeon Guide) + 1 = 4.

rulesClauses: Allies you control get +1 LIFE until end of turn.
